title: MiniMax H3 Metal campaign capture row
description: One machine-readable row from the H3 Metal default-resolution campaign capture (docs/qualification/minimax-h3-metal-next-campaign.md). Emitted at phase entry/exit, chunk boundaries, memory-guard samples, and attempt completion. This is the separate macOS qualification report; it does not describe the Linux CUDA runtime capture schema.

monotonic_ns.description: Nanoseconds from a process-start monotonic anchor; ordering within one process only.

phase.description: H3PipelinePhase Debug name, or attempt/prepare for non-phase rows.

allocated_native_bytes.description: Default malloc-zone bytes in use at sample time. Metal device buffers are not malloc allocations and are never counted here.

native_peak_bytes.description: High-water of allocated_native_bytes within this capture.

requested_allocation_bytes.description: 0 in this capture: individual allocation requests are not observable without allocator interposition. Reserved for instrumented builds.

allocator_ceiling_bytes.description: The derived native-allocation ceiling the campaign guard enforces (gate 4/5 of the campaign document).

process_resident_bytes.description: macOS proc_pidinfo PROC_PIDTASKINFO pti_resident_size. Never added to native Metal allocation: the two may overlap.

process_peak_resident_bytes.description: mach MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO resident_size_max. Labelled as a sample; consecutive differences are never reported as a phase peak.

host_available_bytes.description: Same available-memory source the shipped Metal memory guard samples.

kernel_pressure.description: kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level (1 = normal). 0 marks an unreadable sample, also recorded in error.

budget_phase.description: The applicable phase-budget prefix (one of the fifteen in private_h3_unified_target_peak_bytes), or empty when inapplicable.

budget_host_bytes.description: The per-phase host column stays separate and can be nonzero on Metal; it is never folded into the device column.

budget_combined_bytes.description: The checked device+host sum for this single phase; not an additive total across phases.

budget_binding_maximum.description: True when this prefix is the phase the unified peak binds on.
